## Fraud Transaction Flagger
Rules catch the known patterns; per-customer statistics catch the strange ones.

Your payment system POSTs each transaction with the customer's profile (mean and spread of amounts, known devices and beneficiaries) and the count of their transactions in the last 10 minutes. Returns ALLOW, STEP-UP or BLOCK with reasons; blocks alert the fraud team.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/fraud-transaction-flagger
